items.title: Football: Regular-Season Finale Set for 2 p.m. Kick on ESPN+
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison's 2026 regular-season finale against Coastal Carolina will kick off at 2 p.m. ET, on Saturday, Nov. 28, at Bridgeforth Stadium and will be streamed live on ESPN+, the Sun Belt Conference announced on Monday.

items.title: Football: JMU Falls at UConn
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, Conn. – James Madison went on the road for the final time in the 2026 regular season, falling to UConn, 46-22, on Saturday afternoon at Rentschler Field.

items.title: Football: Scott Becomes Jet Award Finalist
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison wide receiver Michael Scott has been named a finalist for the Jet Award, which honors the most outstanding return specialist in college football, the Jet Award Foundation announced on Wednesday.

items.title: Football: Rea Nominated for Capital One Orange Bowl-FWAA Courage Award
items.summary: DALLAS — James Madison's Patrick Rea is this week's nominee for the 2026 Capital One Orange Bowl-FWAA Courage Award. Rea, a fifth-year punter, uses his position to help raise funds for childhood brain cancer after losing his younger sister to the disease.

items.title: Football: Dukes Travel to UConn for Final Regular-Season Road Trip
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison embarks on its final road trip of the 2026 regular season at UConn on Saturday, Nov. 14. Kickoff at Rentschler Field in East Hartford, Connecticut, is set for noon ET, and the game will air live on CBS Sports Network.

items.title: Football: Suarez Earns Sun Belt Weekly Honor
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison kicker Morgan Suarez has been named the Sun Belt Conference Special Teams Player of the Week, the league announced on Monday.

items.title: Football: Evans Leads Dukes in Road Win at Southern Miss
items.summary: HATTIESBURG, Miss. – James Madison scored 38 second-half points to push the Dukes to a 54-23 win over Southern Miss on Thursday night at Renasant Stadium in Hattiesburg, Mississippi.

items.title: Football: Rea Named to Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison punter Patrick Rea has been named to the Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List, the Augusta Sports Council announced on Wednesday.

items.title: Football: Third Straight Thursday Game Takes JMU to Southern Miss
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison plays its third straight midweek game by traveling to Southern Miss on Thursday, Nov. 5. Kickoff at Renasant Stadium in Hattiesburg, Mississippi, is set for 8 p.m. ET, and the game will air live on ESPN2.

items.title: Football: Dukes Drop Second Straight in OT
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison was plagued by turnovers in a 24-21, overtime loss to Troy on Thursday night at Bridgeforth Stadium.
